title: Dysplastic KRT5+PDPN+ area over damaged alveolar area (PDPN- OR KRT5+)

reason: That spec had the numerator SIGN INVERTED and the denominator wrong, and
mis-quoted the reference to justify both. It claimed Lin et al. Fig 2A-B
quantify 'KRT5+PDPN- areas'. The paper says the opposite.
Verbatim, Lin et al. 2024 (J Clin Invest 134(19):e176828):
Fig 2A-B legend: 'quantification of percentages of KRT5+PDPN+ areas in
Fig 6E-G:        'percentages of dysplastic cell (KRT5+ PDPN+) areas in
PDPN is expressed BY basal/dysplastic cells as well as by AT1, so it does
not discriminate dysplastic tissue from AT1 by absence. Requiring
PDPN-negativity excluded the very population being measured. The old
spec's stated rationale -- that co-negativity rejects autofluorescence --
was an inference of ours, not the paper's method.

rationale: The engine is marker-wise: positiveAreaInRoi() takes ONE marker's mask and
every recomputed fraction divides by region_area_um2. It can express neither
a numerator that is a RELATION between two markers nor a denominator that is
a UNION of two masks. The reference endpoint is both.
This spec declares the relation as DATA so it is reviewable and diffable, and
evaluates it by mask algebra on masks the engine already saves.

terms.note: KRT5+ area after the engine's component filter
PDPN/T1alpha POSITIVE. Co-POSITIVE, per the reference. Dysplastic cells are KRT5+PDPN+.
PDPN-negative: alveolar tissue lacking normal AT1 lining
plus the KRT5+ dysplastic area itself

note: 'damaged alveolar areas (PDPN- and KRT5+)' is the UNION of the two, as the
methods confirm: 'To quantify KRT5+ OR PDPN- area'.
The union is clipped to the analysed region, so it can never exceed
region_area_um2. The script asserts that.
The paper words the numerator two ways. Fig 2A-B says 'KRT5+PDPN+ areas';
Fig 6H-J, Fig 7K-M and Supplemental say 'KRT5+ dysplastic cell areas' and
'KRT5+ lung areas' with no PDPN qualifier. Those are the same quantity only
if essentially all KRT5+ area is also PDPN+.
Rather than pick a reading, emit BOTH and let the data decide. If the ratio
is near 1 the wording is immaterial; if it is not, the choice is a real
analytical decision that must be declared in the methods.
emit: KRT5dysplastic_pod_area_um2      numerator as specified: KRT5+ AND PDPN+
KRT5bare_pod_area_um2            KRT5+ alone, the Fig 6/7 wording
qc_krt5_pdpn_positive_fraction   KRT5+PDPN+ / KRT5+, the number that settles it

naming_note: Ends in _pod_area_um2 so aggregate_to_mouse.classify_columns() puts it in
sum_cols. A name outside that whitelist is SILENTLY DROPPED at mouse level.

note: Derived from uninfected controls only: in-tissue p99.99 was 283 (M4-2)
and 255 (M6); 300 clears both. BUT M6 LEFT is an established
section-level staining failure (AGER frac>500 = 0.0097 vs 0.289 in M6
RIGHT, same antibody and animal), so it cannot corroborate. This value
rests on M4-2 alone and must be re-derived.
PDPN now appears in BOTH numerator (positive) and denominator
(negated), so this threshold moves the endpoint in two directions at
once and a sensitivity sweep is mandatory before any reported number.
The previously proposed value of 200 was derived as a co-NEGATIVITY
ceiling and its justification does not transfer to co-POSITIVITY.

known_limitations: METHOD MISMATCH, the largest one: the reference measured these areas BY HAND
with the Axiovision 4.8 outline spline over a whole-lobe image mosaic on a
widefield BX51. A hand-traced 'damaged alveolar area' is a contiguous
REGION judged at low magnification. A per-pixel PDPN-negative mask is not
the same quantity: it includes every airspace and every gap between AT1
membranes. Expect agreement in direction and magnitude, NOT in value.
Because of that, a regional (spatially closed) denominator variant is
available and is closer in spirit -- see denominator_regional below.
SAMPLING: the reference is a whole left lobe. Ten sampled confocal fields
per mouse cannot reproduce it. This endpoint belongs on the WSI route.
SCALE: the reference uses n = 15 mice per group.
Conducting airways are excluded from neither numerator nor denominator, and
airway basal cells are KRT5+ in every animal including uninfected controls.
Nothing in the 4-channel panel separates airway from injured alveolus.

note: Set a closing radius in um to emulate spline tracing: the PDPN-negative
mask is morphologically closed at that scale so scattered sub-cellular
gaps merge into contiguous damaged REGIONS, which is what a human outlines.
0 (default) = strict per-pixel union, exactly reproducible and clearly
defined but not what the reference measured.
Any non-zero value is a free parameter and must be justified against hand
outlines before use. Do not tune it to make a result appear.

reference.citation: Lin X. et al., J Clin Invest 2024;134(19):e176828
reference.methods_verbatim: Quantification of KRT5+ lung area. To quantify KRT5+ or PDPN- area, the left lung lobes were sectioned and stained for KRT5 and PDPN antibodies, then were imaged by Olympus BX51, and an image mosaic was created using ImageJ software. The KRT5+ or PDPN- areas were measured using outline spline in the measure menu of Axiovision 4.8.
